exposure: Ultrasound-guided transverse abdominis plane block with 0.25% bupivacaine
Ultrasound-guided transverse abdominis plane block with 0.2% ropivacaine
outcome: Time for full regression of block
Time required for first rescue analgesia
Visual Analog Scale (VAS) score during rest
cohort: Pregnant women aged 20 to 35 years, with ASA physical status II or III, undergoing elective and emergency caesarean section under spinal anesthesia.
finding: Analgesic efficacy and safety of Bupivacaine and Ropivacaine were found to be almost similar in TAP block for pain management after Caesarean section.
